# UnlockBuffer <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Buffers and Pixels](BlitzBasic-Buffers-and-Pixels)

</div>


```blitzbasic
UnlockBuffer:Void buffer:Int32=0
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `buffer` | In | Int32 | `0` | The buffer to unlock. Defaults to the current buffer. |

## Description

Ends the lock of [LockBuffer](LockBuffer) and writes the pixels that were changed into the buffer. It does nothing if the buffer is not locked.
